attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 18 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The whole notice is one sentence — «Τη μνήμη του βρίσκουμε μόνο στον Παρισινό Κώδικα 1578 χωρίς κάποια άλλη προσθήκη» — we find his memory only in the Paris codex 1578, with nothing else added. The one `type` is the line's own «Όσιος». **No `dates`, no `locations`, no `related` and no hymn**: the codex carries no notice, so the page has nothing else, and the paragraph the page prints about the name Basil is an etymology and a note on emperors of that name, not about this man. The corpus holds many folders named Basil and none of them is kept on 18 November in any calendar, so the slug and the display name carry the day. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (2 October 2026).
